Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

REINFORCED ( FLEXO-METALLIC)MAGlLUS 

ENDOTRACHEAL TUBE 



•• Scope- Requirements for reinforced (flexo-metallic)Magill's endotracheal tubes made of natural 
rubber. 

Z» Material 

2.1 The tubes shall be made of natural rubber compound in accordance with requirements given in 3 of 
IS : 658 I - 1972 (Specification for endotracheal tubes ( rubber) *, 

2.2 Reinforcing Helix — It shall be made of corrosion-resisting metal, spring-tempered. The free ends of 
the helix shall be secured so that they will not break away to project through the outer surface of the 
tube. 

3. Shape and Dimensions-As indicated in Fig. K

ENOOTRACHEAL TUBE 



3»lTheinternal diameter and the wail thickness of the unreinforced tube for sizes 3'0to5-0 shall be in 
accordance with the requirements for oral endotratheai tubes given In Table 2 of IS: 658 1- 1972* The 
internal diameter and wall thickness of the unreinforced tube for size SS, 60 and 6-5 shall be in accord- 
ance wlchthe requirements for nasal endotracheal tubes given in Table 2 of IS:6S8I-I972. 

3.2 Nasal tubes of size 5*0 or less and all oral tubes shall have the angle of bevel of about 45* in relation 
to the axis of the tube. Nasal tube of size 5'S or greater shall have the angle of bevel of about 30* in 
relation to the axis of the tube. Unless otherwise specified by the purchaser, the bevel of oral tubes 
shall have the opening facing to the left when the tube is viewed from the concave aspect of the vertical 
plane, bevel end uppermost. Nasal tubes may have the bevel facing in either direction.

IS: 6807- 1972 

3.3 The actual internal diameter of the endotracheal tube shall be the nominal diameter subject to a 
tolerance of db 0*2 mm. 

3.4 Internal diameter of the reinforcing helix shall be approximately equal to but not less than the 
internal diameter of the unreinforced tube. 

4. IVIarking-The tubes shall be durably and legibly marked as follows: 

a) The size number as given in Fig. I, 

b) The name or trade-mark of the manufacturer, and 

c) The number of Indian Standard, that is, IS: 6807. 

5. Packing-Shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
